title: Broken Moonlantern
summary: Combine a broken Moonlantern with a dead pixie in Balthazar’s lab to create a Shadow Lantern when Gale is in the party.

fields.Effect: Combine a broken Moonlantern with a dead pixie in Balthazar’s lab to create a Shadow Lantern when Gale is in the party.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
